## Choline Types  
Several distinguishable types of choline are indeed found in some food (i.e., whole grains, vegetables, & fruits), in your body, or certain supplements. Here’s a list of what you must understand regarding the most standard ones [\[2\]](http://documents.grenadine.co/Syncopate%20Meetings%20&%20Events,%20LLC/American%20Association%20of%20Naturopathic%20Physicians%20Annual%20Conference/BrandesHandout_13Brandes.pdf):  
- Choline bitartrate: It’s the most regular supplemental form of choline — about 40% choline by weight, & is incredibly affordable, but not as well-absorbed or used by the body as some different choline forms. It can maintain memory recall, maintain neuromuscular function muscles as you age, & support healthy liver function, etc.;
- Citicoline: Also understood as cytidine diphosphate-choline (or CDP-choline), it is a widely utilized nootropic & a precursor to uridine, one of the major 5 nucleic acids utilized by the body to build DNA. It has 18% choline & certainly boasts some remarkable cognitive advantages. It undoubtedly aids memory loss due to aging, ameliorates vision in individuals with glaucoma, & also supports recovery in stroke patients. CDP-choline is also utilized for the treatment of Alzheimer’s & Parkinson’s disease, lazy eye, bipolar disorder, as well as other conditions of the brain [\[3\]](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins/ai/ingredientmono-1090/citicoline);
- helps support heart health: Choline together with folate helps in the conversion of homocysteine, which thwarts the body from stashing too much fat. It may be advantageous in cutting down on the risk of experiencing a heart attack or stroke [\[10\]](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/15699233). Choline & lecithin can assist to lessen blood cholesterol as well as the risk for heart disease. However, different investigations have yielded conflicting results, so more study is still required before physicians will begin to prescribe choline for its capability to decrease LDL (“bad”) cholesterol & triglycerides[\[11\]](https://www.healthcentral.com/article/choline-and-carnitine-good-or-bad-for-heart-health).  
Choline also supports DNA synthesis as well as fetal & infant brain development. Indeed, pregnant women are frequently advised to take choline in complement to their prenatal vitamins. The nutrient is also good for weight loss. It aids the body burn fat, resulting in more effortless weight loss & certainly better metabolic health.
